records.summary: Dell Technologies reported mixed fiscal Q4 2024 results with revenue declines but increased diluted earnings per share and a 20% increase in its annual cash dividend, alongside significant advancements in AI and cybersecurity solutions.
records.catalyst: Strong cash flow, increased dividend, and strategic advancements in AI, including new enterprise data storage for AI workloads and AI-accelerated laptops, and expanded security offerings.
records.risk: Year-over-year revenue declines in both the fourth quarter and full fiscal year 2024.

records.summary: Vistra Corp. completed its acquisition of Energy Harbor, significantly expanding its nuclear generation capacity and retail customer base, and reported improved full-year 2023 financial results while authorizing an additional $1.5 billion in share repurchases.
records.catalyst: Completion of the Energy Harbor acquisition, adding over 4,000 MW of nuclear generation and approximately 1 million retail customers, along with strong financial performance and a substantial share repurchase authorization.
